book.name: 1 THESSALONIANS
book.title: Id ash d Paul Wehpeg Oꞌohana am ha Wui g Thessalonica t Am Wohochuddam

content: Mo has mahs doakag d Jiosh hohhoꞌida.

Pegih, t-wepnag, am ach wa em-ahgid mamt has masma wo himad g e-doakag ch hab wo hohhoꞌidach g Jiosh. Ab amt bei g haꞌichu t-ahga. Kuch hemuch ab si em-tahni ch ab em-chehani am wehhejed g t-kownalig Jesus mamt baꞌich am hab wo i junihid.
S-mahch am mach wa has masma am em-shelinid g gewkdajkaj.
Jiosh o em-tatchuid mamt ab wo si i e gawulkai pi apꞌekam amjed k wo si e nuhkud g hejel e-wehm kihkam wehhejed.
Ahpim chechoj amt wo s-mahchk mamt wo si s-ap ha hohnt am tahgio g Jiosh ch am hemajkam ha tahgio.
Hegam mo pi mahch g Jiosh o wabsh hejel e-tatchui wehhejed bebhe g uwi. Mt wabshaba ahpim pi hab masma wo be
k hab pi ab hu hedai wui pi ap has wo chuꞌi. Heki ach hu am em-ahgid mat g Jiosh s-koꞌokam wo ha namkid matp hedai am hab wo juh ihda pi apꞌekam.
Jiosh at pi hab ahgk ab i t-gawulkai machs am hab wo junihid g s-uam haꞌichu. Do tatchuij matt d wo hekia s-apꞌekamk.
K heg hekaj ab t-mahkch g Hekia S-apꞌekam Gewkdag. Hegai matp hedai wo s-ohhod ihda mashchama at wo s-ohhod g Jiosh.
Heki atsh hu i em-tashogi g Jiosh mamt wo si pihk e elidad wehs ha hekaj g e-wehm wohochuddam. K pi hab chum mahs machs am hu ep wo ge em-oꞌohani ab amjed.
Si amsh pihk e elid wehs ha hekaj g e-wehm wohochuddam am wehs Macedonia jewed ch ed. Kuch wabshaba ab si em-tahni mamt baꞌich am hab wo i e junihid.
Am g wo i e nakog mamt wo s-dodolimak ch am hab wo junihid g hejel e-chikpan ch wo haꞌichu e gahgidad. Id ach wa heki hu hab em-ahgid.
Bamt masma pi hedai ab hu wo hiwgad mas ab wabsh wo em-mah hegai mam haschu i tatchua. T hegam mo pi mahch g Jiosh wo em-nei mam s-chikpnadag k ab wo si has em-elidad.
T-kownalig jiwhiadag.
Si ach em-tatchuid mamt wo s-mahchk g wohokam ab ha amjed hegam mat heki hu koi. T hahawa pi wo i em-bijim g pi ap tahhadkam hab masma mat hab wo ha juh g pi wohochuddam.
Neh, ab at i wuhsh g Jesus muhkig amjed. Kuch s-wohochud ihda ch hekaj ab wui nenea mat g Jiosh ab ep wo i ha wuwhas hegam mat koi ab s-wohochudch g haꞌichu ahgaj ab amjed g Jesus.
Hegam atsh wo i wuwha ab amjed g muhkig matt koi an hu wo nam g t-kownalig Jesus.

Wehpeg at ab wo si s-kaidam t-wai g anghil ha-geꞌejig. T g Jiosh kuikud ab haha wo kaida. T ab haha wo i hud g t-kownalig Jesus ab dahm kahchim t amjed. T hegam mat heki hu koi ab s-wohochudch g Jesus ab wo i wuwha.
T hegam mat hedai in d wo kia dodakamk heg i tash ed ab haha wo i e hemapai ha wehm chewagi ch ed k an wo nam g t-kownalig. Kutt am i amjed chum hekid wo wehmajk g t-kownalig.
Ab g wo si e gewkemhunad id hekaj haꞌichu ahga.
